body: Ito ang klase ng signal na mas interesting kapag katabi ng earlier physical-AI ecosystem evidence: hindi bagong robot announcement, kundi measurement + interoperability + lab automation. Pero fair warning: JASIS is still an exhibit, not a factory KPI. If several vendors show production deployments with transferable data pipelines and quantified uptime/yield gains, mas lalakas ang pattern na Japan is building the boring-but-essential implementation layer. Boring plumbing, exciting consequences.

claims.text: JASIS LabDX and metrology content may represent an additional implementation-layer signal within Japan's broader physical-AI ecosystem, but trade-show presence alone does not establish production adoption.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's sourced LabDX/metrology program and the existing ALAM physical-AI trend record.
